questions.question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

Being a doktor, my sister Meera is prepared for an emergency usually.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"doktor"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**doctor**". (डॉक्टर)
 
• **​"Doctor"** refers to a person who is qualified to treat people who are ill. (डॉक्टर)
 
 
• **Example:** The **doctor **advised him to take a week off work to recover.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prepared** (तैयार): Made ready for use or consideration.

 
 
• **Example:** She was well **prepared **for the exam.
 
 
 
• **Usually** (आमतौर पर): Under normal conditions; generally.
 
 
• **Example:** He **usually **gets home by 6 PM.
 
 
 
• **Emergency** (आपातकाल): A serious, unexpected, and often dangerous situation requiring immediate action.
 
 
• **Example:** In case of an **emergency**, dial 100.

questions.question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The questionnaire appeared to be misrably designed.
questions.solution:
The erroneous spelling is: **misrably**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"misrably"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling should be "miserably". (दुखी)
 
• The correct word **"miserably"** means in a way that shows unhappiness or discomfort. (दुखी)
 
 
• **Example:** She looked miserably at the broken toy.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **misrably**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Designed** (डिज़ाइन किया हुआ): Planned or created with a specific purpose or intention.

 
 
• **Example:** The house was designed by a famous architect.
 
 
 
• **Questionnaire** (प्रश्नावली): A set of printed or written questions used for gathering information.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to fill out the questionnaire for the survey.
 
 
 
• **Appeared** (प्रकट हुआ): Become visible or come into sight.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician appeared on the stage out of nowhere.

questions.solution:

__
 
• The correct spelling is "Resurrection", which is derived from the Latin word "resurrectio" meaning "rising again." (पुनर्जीवन)
 
• The word **"Resurrection"** means the act of rising from the dead or bringing something back to life, revival, or renewal.
 
 
• **Example:** The story of Jesus Christ's **resurrection **is central to the Christian faith.
